procedure Main();
begin
  begin
    a;
    b
  end;

  begin
    begin
    end
  end;

  begin
    if a then
      b
  end;

  begin
    if a then
      if b then
        c
  end;

  begin
    if a then
    begin
      b
    end
  end;

  begin
    if a then
      b
    else
      c
  end;

  begin
    if a then
    begin
      b
    end
    else
    begin
      c
    end
  end;

  begin
    while a do
      b
  end;

  begin
    repeat
      a
    until b
  end;

  begin
    for a := b to c do
      a
  end;

  begin
    for a := b to c do
    begin
      a
    end
  end;

  begin
    case a of
      b: c;
      d: e
    end
  end;

  begin
    case a of
      b: c;
      else
        d
    end
  end;

  begin
    try
      a
    finally
      b
    end
  end;

  begin
    try
      a
    except
      b
    end
  end;

  begin
    with a do
      b
  end;

  begin
    a := b
  end;

  begin
    goto a
  end;

end;
